title: Nelson Tasman — Tahunanui Beach

facts.fact: Tahunanui is Nelson coastal recreation with approximately1.75km of sand; no daily swim safety guarantee.
The listed area is at Rocks Road; tide affects shoreline experience.
Dogs are restricted to Back Beach rather than the two eastern thirds.
Marketing mentions paddling or swimming to offshore landmarks; this guide does not reproduce that as safe activity advice.
